outcome: hypercoagulability (measured by thromboelastometry (TEM) and thrombin generation (TG))
cohort: The study included 99 pregnant women with VTE risk factors.
finding: The pattern of postpartum hypercoagulability in women with VTE risk factors was similar irrespective of mode of delivery.
mod_finding: The pattern of postpartum hypercoagulability was similar irrespective of mode of delivery, suggesting minimal differences in hypercoagulability markers between vaginal delivery and caesarean section groups post-delivery.
